_sagegui.name: Tryptic — open
_sagegui.description: Open search for unknown-modification discovery. Precursor window is DELTA MASS -100 to +500 Da, which in Sage's raw convention is written [-500, 100] (negated and reversed). Read that carefully: a +500 Da modification is found by the -500 LOWER bound, not by a +500 upper bound. Expect a long run and a much larger search space; consider lowering max_variable_mods if memory is tight.
